The season began in the second week of August 2012. [[Orlando Pirates F.C.|Orlando Pirates]] were the defending champions, having won the previous [[2011–12 Premier Soccer League|2011–12]] season, but lost their title to [[Kaizer Chiefs]]. The season featured 14 teams from the 2011-12 season and two new teams promoted from the [[2011–12 National First Division]]: [[University of Pretoria F.C.|Tuks FC]] and [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]] who replacer relegated [[Santos Football Club (South Africa)|Santos]] and [[Jomo Cosmos]]. ==Format changes== The 2012–13 season saw the introduction of the [[PSL Q-innovation|Q-innovation]] system. The league schedule was split into four fixture-blocks referred to as quarters, the first and third blocks had eight fixtures, the second and fourth blocks had seven fixtures.{{cite web|title=PSL launch exciting Q-Innovation for the Absa Premiership|url=http://www.psl.co.za/article.asp?id=1525961|publisher=PSL|access-date=10 August 2012|date=10 August 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120901074724/http://www.psl.co.za/article.asp?id=1525961|archive-date=1 September 2012|url-status=dead}} Prize money was given to the teams who finish top of the table after each block of fixtures. ==Prize money== {| class=wikitable !Achievement !Prize money |- |1st place at end of quarter 1 |1.5m ZAR |- |1st place at end of quarter 2 |1.5m ZAR |- |1st place at end of quarter 3 |1.5m ZAR |- |1st place at end of quarter 4 |1.5m ZAR |- |Overall league winner |10m ZAR |} ==Teams== A total of 16 teams contested the league, including 14 sides from the [[2011–12 Premier Soccer League|2011–12 season]] and two promoted from the [[2011–12 National First Division]]. Relegation for [[Jomo Cosmos]] to the [[2012–13 National First Division]] was confirmed on 16 May 2012, as ''Jomo Cosmos'' maintained their reputation as a [[yo-yo club]], suffering their third relegation from the Premiership in five seasons.{{cite web|title=Jomo Cosmos relegated from the PSL after draw with Black Leopards|url=http://www.kickoff.com/league/psl/match-report/7060/jomo-cosmos-relegated-for-the-psl-after-draw-with-black-leopards.php|publisher=Kickoff.com|access-date=16 July 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120521204121/http://www.kickoff.com/league/psl/match-report/7060/jomo-cosmos-relegated-for-the-psl-after-draw-with-black-leopards.php|archive-date=21 May 2012|url-status=dead}} [[Santos Football Club (South Africa)|Santos]] had finished 15th and thus had to go through the [[2011–12 National First Division#PSL playoff tournament|2011-12 PSL Playoff Tournament]] alongside [[Chippa United]] and [[Thanda Royal Zulu F.C.|Thanda Royal Zulu]] of the [[National First Division]]. ''Santos'' were unable to retain their place in the Premiership following a 4–3 defeat in the final game of the Playoff Tournament on 30 June 2012 and were subsequently relegated to the National First Division for the [[2012-13 National First Division|2012-13 season]].{{cite web|title=Santos relegated from PSL|url=http://www.sport24.co.za/Soccer/PSL/Santos-relegated-from-PSL-20120630|publisher=Sport24|access-date=16 July 2012}} [[University of Pretoria F.C.|Tuks FC]] earned promotion to the Premiership as 2011-12 National First Division Champions.{{cite web|title=Celebrations as Tuks savour Premier Division promotion|url=http://psl.co.za/article.asp?id=1380421|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130422002500/http://psl.co.za/article.asp?id=1380421|url-status=dead|archive-date=22 April 2013|publisher=PSL|access-date=17 July 2012}} [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]], who had finished second in the 2011-12 National First Division season, earned their place in the PSL after defeating [[Santos Football Club (South Africa)|Santos]] and [[Thanda Royal Zulu F.C.|Thanda Royal Zulu]] in the 3-team PSL promotion tournament. Both teams made their first appearances in the PSL. ===Stadiums and locations=== Football teams in South Africa tend to use multiple stadiums over the course of a season for their home games. 2) goal difference; 3) number of goals scored. |update=18 May 2013 |source=[http://www.kickoff.com/league/201213-absa-premiership/match-centre#tab_mc-table kickoff.com] }} ==PSL playoff tournament== The teams that finished second and third during the ''2012-13 National First Division'' season were joined by the team that finished 15th in the Premiership in a 3-team promotion and relegation playoff called the '''PSL Playoff Tournament'''. === Participants === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" |- !width="175"|Team !width"175"|League !width="20"|{{Tooltip|Pos|Position}} |- |align="left"| [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]]||Premiership||15th |- |align="left"| [[Santos Football Club (South Africa)|Santos]]||2012–13 National First Division||2nd |- |align="left"| [[Mpumalanga Black Aces F.C.|Mpumalanga Black Aces]]||2012–13 National First Division||3rd |} === Format === The 3 teams participated in a mini-league in which they played one another twice (home and away) with log points being awarded for winning a match (3 points) and drawing a match (1 point). At the conclusion of the mini-league phase the team that was in first place would either earn or maintain their place in the [[South African Premiership|Premiership]] for the [[2013–14 South African Premiership|2013-14 season]]. If the team that finished 15th in the league was unable to win the mini-league, they were relegated to the National First Division for the 2013–14 season. === Playoff table === {| class="wikitable" style="text-align: center;" |- !width="20"|{{Tooltip|Pos|Position}} !width="175"|Team !width="20"|{{Tooltip|Pld|Played}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|W|Won}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|D|Draw}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|L|Lost}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|GF|Goals For}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|GA|Goals Against}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|GD|Goal Difference}} !width="20"|{{Tooltip|Pts|Points}} !width=250|Qualification or relegation |- |1||align="left"| [[Mpumalanga Black Aces F.C.|Mpumalanga Black Aces]] '''(P)'''||4||2||2||0||4||2||+2||'''8''' |- |2||align="left"| [[Chippa United F.C.|Chippa United]] '''(R)'''||4||1||2||1||1||1||0||'''5'''|| |- |3||align="left"| [[Santos Football Club (South Africa)|Santos]]||4||0||2||2||2||4||–2||'''2'''|| |} Pld = Matches played; W = Matches won; D = Matches drawn; L = Matches lost; GF = Goals for; GA = Goals against; GD = Goal difference; Pts = Points
